title: Short-term response to anti-VEGF as indicator of visual prognosis in refractory age-related macular degeneration

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License)

condition: Neovascular AMD refractory to monthly anti-VEGF (intraretinal and/or subretinal fluid at every monitoring visit for 6 months or more after at least 12 months of anti-VEGF; same agent for at least 6 months); monocentric retrospective chart and OCT review (Jules Gonin Eye Hospital, Lausanne), 45 eyes of 41 patients, one injection cycle analysed per eye

groups.agent: ranibizumab (22 eyes) or aflibercept (23 eyes), the agent used in the 6 months before baseline and directly thereafter
groups.description: All study eyes: OCT just before an anti-VEGF injection (study baseline), at an intermediate visit 1 week after that injection and at the following visit 1 month after the injection

exclusions.what: Table 1 rows: time interval from last injection, visual acuity, maximum ILM-RPE distance, maximum RPE elevation, AI fluid volumes (IRF, SRF, PED)
exclusions.reason: not central retinal thickness (maximum-height and volume measures are not the central value)

exclusions.what: Table 2 'CRT change at initiation of anti-VEGF treatment' (and the Results-text CRT before/after the initial loading doses years earlier)
exclusions.reason: a single change without a tabulated baseline thickness in the same series; the before/after values exist only in the text; different (historical) treatment period
choroidal thickness is out of scope

exclusions.what: Figure 2 subgroups by >=70% fluid responsiveness at week 1
exclusions.reason: groups defined by a post-baseline outcome (response); visual acuity only

exclusions.what: Table 3 associations with long-term visual outcome
exclusions.reason: correlation/regression statistics and visual acuity, not thickness series

notes: Time origin: the anti-VEGF injection given at the study-baseline visit (the visit just before the injection); eyes had a mean of 27 prior injections, prior_treatment previously_treated
CRT measured on Heidelberg Spectralis (macular cube 6 mm, 49 lines); the Methods do not define CRT as the central 1-mm subfield, so measure central_unspecified
Regimen labelled single: exactly one injection falls between the baseline visit and the 1-month visit (routine practice was monthly injections while fluid persisted)
Visual acuity, fluid volumes and long-term visual follow-up exist but are not extracted

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Table 1 row 'CRT (µm ± SD)', column Baseline: visit just before the injection)
series.notes: Mean ± SD; 1 week = 7/30.4375 months (0.2300) after the baseline injection; 1 month after the injection is the next visit (next injection given then); per-visit n not separately reported (paired t-tests over the 45 eyes); eyes were on ongoing monthly injections, the reported period contains exactly one injection
